errors.evidence: The reference description states that the Welthandel bar is light green (hellgrün), not yellow-green (Gelbgrün).
The reference description states that the Industrieproduktion Deutschland bar is light blue (hellblau), not light blue-gray (Blaugrau).
The reference description explicitly mentions the exact color mapping in the legend (dunkelgrün, hellgrün, dunkelblau, hellblau), which the machine-generated description does not fully replicate.

The reference description explicitly states the chart illustrates 'prozentualen Durchschnittswerte des Welt-BIP, Welthandels, der Exporte Deutschlands und der Industrieproduktion Deutschlands.' The machine-generated description omits this explicit purpose, though it is implied.
